text: Two banks from Thrissur, both about a hundred years old, are turning into gold loan banks.
Clue one. C S B Bank. Gold loans are now fifty three percent of all its loans, up from forty seven.
Clue two. Dhanlaxmi Bank. Forty three percent, up from thirty four.
The twist. At Dhanlaxmi, gold and small business loans grew more than the whole book. Everything else shrank.
Gold loans are secured, so today's book looks safe. But it's one bet, on one metal. What if gold prices fall? Back to the napkin.
